scope: experimental cleanup host adapters, scheduler and durable session event wiring
coverage: Local fake GitHub/Gitea JSON HTTP list/delete endpoints, query pagination through empty page and deletion verification
No redirects, unconfigured scope rejection, malformed responses and authorization denial
Protected owner-only regular credential files, read-only file mode and symlink rejection
Durable deduplicated session/device event queue, restart replay and corruption rejection
Logout, client revocation, observed expiry, account disablement and password change hooks
Logout queue failure returns error and retains session for retry
Single worker lifetime lock and cleanup of previous-process leases at startup
Persisted round-robin sweep cursor and bounded passes
Existing entry/journal/identity and account regression suite
limits: Fake hosts use test-only loopback HTTP; production configuration requires HTTPS with normal certificate verification
No real GitHub/Gitea permissions, certificates, rate limits or SSH transfer tested
Registration/issuance, sync-completion hook, cryptographic device-removal admission and status UI remain pending
Cleanup scheduler is explicitly opt-in and was not started against any real configuration
Account sessions are process-local; this wiring is not a distributed session/worker protocol
API deletion is cleanup-dependent lifetime; strict remote TTL still requires certificates or a lease-checking gateway
Partial account storage failure after event queueing may conservatively revoke transport access
Vault-secret biometric access enforcement remains a separate experimental workstream
